purpose: Test whether common Sobol was an artificially weak external control and report source-plus-search cost fairness without changing the frozen method.

low_frequency_grid_n13.initial_design: ten constant integer policies at equally spaced declared levels from 0 to 100

common_sobol_n397.cost_match: 384 frozen source calls plus 13 target search calls

decision_rule.if_low_frequency_grid_matches_or_beats_f: Energy is reported as feasibility-transfer evidence and a limitation, not source-learning superiority over a domain-natural structural control.
decision_rule.if_common_sobol_n397_matches_or_beats_fr: The external result does not support total-cost superiority and is reported only in the archive-available regime.

result_disposition.manuscript_obligation: Report the natural low-frequency control as statistically indistinguishable from the frozen atlas on GB_GBN; do not claim external source-learning superiority.
